identification.item_name: Herman Miller Aeron Office Chair, Size B
identification.materials: Pellicle mesh, aluminum frame and base
identification.description: A Herman Miller Aeron task chair, Size B, in graphite Pellicle mesh with a polished aluminum base. Purchased new and used daily in a home office.
identification.identifying_details: Size B tag and serial number visible on the underside of the seat pan

condition.condition_observations: Right armrest pad shows visible cracking; casters show light scuffing consistent with normal use; no tears in the mesh.
condition.natural_characteristics: Faint sheen on the armrests from years of hand contact -- not a defect.
condition.possible_hidden_defects: Gas cylinder and tilt mechanism not tested under sustained load; recommend a function check before sale.
condition.cleanliness: Clean; lightly dusted in the base crevices.
condition.structural_condition: Solid. No wobble in the base or frame.
condition.functional_condition: Recline, tilt-tension, and height adjustment all operate correctly. Armrest height adjustment is stiff on the right side.
condition.cleaning_recommendations: Wipe down the mesh and base; compressed air for the base crevices.
condition.repair_recommendations: Replace the right armrest pad if a premium price is desired; not required for a Good-condition sale.
condition.condition_price_impact: Armrest pad wear and stiff adjustment justify Good rather than Excellent; otherwise a strong seller.
